gloss: to pass through; to duck under; to go through

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {潜|くぐ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to pass through, to go under, to duck under
definitions.explanation: To move through a narrow opening, under a low barrier, or through a gate or tunnel.
To get through a dangerous or difficult situation, implying having survived many hardships.

examples.japanese: ⟦トンネル→トンネル：03865_tonneru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{潜|くぐ}る。
⟦{鳥居|とりい}→鳥居：05956_torii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{潜|くぐ}って⟦{境内|けいだい}→境内：12095_keidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I passed through the torii gate and entered the shrine grounds.

examples.japanese: ⟦フェンス→フェンス：26996_fensu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{潜|くぐ}って⟦{向|む}こう{側|がわ}→向こう側：08504_mukougawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I ducked under the fence and came out on the other side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{修羅場|しゅらば}→修羅場：10599_shuraba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{潜|くぐ}ってきた。
examples.english: I've been through many tough situations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{潜|くぐ}り{抜|ぬ}けた。
examples.english: I made it through the danger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{死線|しせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{潜|くぐ}り{抜|ぬ}けてきた⟦ベテラン→ベテラン：11121_beteran⟧⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧だ。
examples.english: He's a veteran soldier who has survived many life-threatening situations.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ particle: ⟦トンネル→トンネル：03865_tonneru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{潜|くぐ}る

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{鳥居|とりい}→鳥居：05956_torii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{潜|くぐ}る: to pass through a torii gate
- ⟦トンネル→トンネル：03865_tonneru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{潜|くぐ}る: to go through a tunnel
- ⟦{暖簾|のれん}→暖簾：05803_noren⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{潜|くぐ}る: to enter through a noren curtain
- ⟦{修羅場|しゅらば}→修羅場：10599_shuraba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{潜|くぐ}る: to go through tough times
- {潜|くぐ}り{抜|ぬ}ける: to make it through, to slip through

NOTE: Not to be confused with {潜|もぐ}る (same kanji, different reading), which means to dive underwater or to hide.
